title: Five-Dimensional Compatibility and Stratified Local-Unitary Structure of Pure Three-Qubit States
summary: We investigates the joint compatibility problem of the three pairwise concurrences, the three-tangle, and the Kempe invariant in arbitrary pure three-qubit states, and gives necessary and sufficient conditions for these five quantities to be simultaneously realizable by the same pure state. This five-dimensional compatibility region can be viewed as a fiber structure over the previously derived four-dimensional reachable region.
